heroSummary: Chandler Unified School District starts the 2028–29 school year on Wednesday, July 19, 2028. The calendar lists first intersession from September 25 through October 6, second intersession from December 25 through January 5, and third intersession from March 12–23. The last day of school is Friday, May 25, 2029, with a half-day schedule.
calendarNotes: The CUSD 2028–29 calendar lists 180 student days and 190 teacher days. It keeps Chandler Unified's early-start intersession pattern, with teacher inservice/workdays before students return and after major intersessions. Families should also note that Veterans Day is observed on November 10 and the second intersession continues through January 5 before a January 8 teacher workday.

calendarFaqs.a: Chandler Unified starts the 2028–29 school year on Wednesday, July 19, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CUSD fall intersession in 2028?

calendarFaqs.q: When is CUSD spring intersession in 2029?
Are CUSD teacher inservice/workdays student days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Teacher inservice/workdays are no-school days for students.
